children: Activist investor Flashlight Capital Partners has requested to inspect the shareholder registers of five units of the powerful Samsung conglomerate that hold a substantial stake in S-1 Corporation
, escalating a campaign to improve returns at the South Korean security company.

Sanghyun Lee, the founder and CEO of Singapore-based Flashlight, is seeking to reach out directly to shareholders of five units of the chaebol that appear to exert outsized influence over S-1, which has lagged the returns of the benchmark KOSPI
